about: This title is included in Borderlands Collection: Pandora's Box!
Includes both PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 digital versions of New Tales from the Borderlands**.

Within the perpetually war-torn metropolis of Promethea, you'll control Anu, Octavio, and Fran on the worst day of their lives. Help these three lovable losers as they endeavor to change the world (and maybe even save it)!
It's time to fight back against exploitation and corporate greed. It's time to make Mayhem your business.
THE UNDERDOG STORY OF THREE LOVABLE NOBODIES
Decide the fates of altruistic scientist Anu, her ambitious, ""streetwise"" brother Octavio, and the fierce, frogurt-slinging Fran.
